sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “WP CV Builder”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Navigate to CV Builder settings to configure your options

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/wp-cv-builder/ directory
  3. Extract the files
  4. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  5. Configure settings in the CV Builder admin panel1. Upload the wp-resume-builder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  6. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  7. After activation, navigate to the ‘CV Builder’ settings page to configure options.
  8. Use the ‘CV Builder’ widget within the Elementor editor to start creating resumes.
sections.faq:
What is WP CV Builder SaaS, and how does it work?

It’s your golden ticket to the resume business! WP CV Builder transforms your WordPress site into a money-making resume platform. Users create stunning CVs using 25+ pro templates, download instantly, and you get paid through seamless PayPal integration.

Do I need coding or design skills?

ABSOLUTELY NOT! We built this for real people, not tech wizards. If you can click a mouse, you can run a profitable resume business. Install, pick templates, start earning – it’s literally that easy!

Can I use this on multiple websites?

YES! Unlimited sites included with the Pro version! Perfect for agencies scaling across multiple domains, or entrepreneurs building an empire. One purchase, infinite possibilities!

What payment options are supported?

PayPal integration that actually works! Charge per resume or set up recurring subscriptions. More payment gateways coming soon to maximize your earning potential!

What’s included with my purchase?

EVERYTHING you need for success! Complete plugin + PayPal integration + all templates + marketing guide + VIP support + lifetime updates. We’ve got your back from day one!
